text: 🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon, on Aston Villa: “I’ve played against them several times, and they’re in good form at the moment. They’re always focused and wait for their opportunities. It will be a challenge, but I’m looking forward to tomorrow’s game.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “The challenge of playing for Barça is different from anywhere else. Before, I was competing to qualify for the Champions League; now, I’m competing to win every trophy.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “Scoring goals and providing assists can change the course of a match. That’s what I want to improve on. I think there are moments when I should be more individualistic, but my main aim is to help the team.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “I don’t think the teams we’ve lost to are better than us. It's on us. We have to take responsibility for those defeats.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “I think we were the better team against Real Madrid, but our failure to recover properly physically took its toll on us.” #fcblive 👀

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “It’s my first time living outside England. It’s very different, and I feel fortunate to be here: the weather, the food, the people… Everything is great. Many players could have big egos, but that’s not the case here. Everyone is humble.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “Sometimes I need to be more selfish, pass the ball less and try to dribble more. Above all, I want to score more goals and provide more assists, because that’s what decides matches.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “My family is very happy here, and I’ve built an excellent connection with the fans. Seeing banners dedicated to me has made me really happy. I want to give everything in return for the love and support they’ve shown me. They’ve shown me so much affection, and I want to repay them by scoring even more goals.” #fcblive

🚨 Hansi Flick's press-conference:

“I think the team is capable of meeting the demands we set as a coaching staff. We’re convinced about what we want to achieve and, so far, we’re satisfied with the process.” #fcblive #UCL
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Christensen? He trained with us yesterday but only a little bit. We will have to see if he's available on the weekend. For now, he's out for tomorrow.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Alejandro Balde: “I think his situation is normal. When you don’t play regularly, you can lose confidence. What I’m seeing now is that he’s getting better with every training session. We'll see who plays, but Cancelo is also doing a great job.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “I spoke to Balde and told him that this is normal. I have great respect for Balde, and I’m trying to help him regain his confidence. That’s what the coaching staff should do. He’s working hard to get back to his best, and I’m happy for him.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “I think the result in El Clásico could have been different. We’ve won 11 games, but people are focusing more on the two defeats. Our objective is to finish in the Champions League top eight.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Barcelona’s defensive injuries: “We have four injured players: Xavi Espart, Eric, Christensen and Koundé. Xavi might return at the start of 2027, others are likely to return after the int'l break.

It’s not easy to manage, but Frenkie is there, coming back from injury and WILLING to help, just like Brian Fariñas.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick, on Gavi's situation: “We all know Gavi’s quality, and he’s always an option. I’ve spoken to him to make sure he understands how we feel about him. He’s very important to us.

I don’t see him playing at right-back. He’s always an option to come on, but sometimes the course of a match prevents us from following our plans. He knows what I think of him, and I can see that he’s confident.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Brian Fariñas has a good understanding with Lamine. He’s an option at RIGHT-BACK for tomorrow’s game.”

“Gerard Martín at LB? Yes, he's an option both at CB and at LB. We'll decide who plays.” #fcblive
🚨 Hansi Flick has indicated at the press-conference that Brian Fariñas will again START at right-back tomorrow vs. Aston Villa.

🚨🗣️ @FabrizioRomano: "Barcelona wanted Balde to go in the summer in case of good proposals but he wanted to stay and fight for his place. So the player was NOT pushing to leave Barca. Balde loves Barca. So he wanted to continue at Barcelona, who were open to letting him go. That's the situation. Then there was no agreements with any club also because Barça were not letting Balde go on loan or on an easy deal in the summer. It has to be a BIG proposal or nothing." #fcblive
🚨🗣️ @FabrizioRomano: "Gavi is still considered by Barcelona as a KEY player. There's no transfer alert." #fcblive
